systems.system: منظومة التحول الرقمي (Public Prosecution digital transformation system, launched January 2023)
systems.tiers: Public Prosecution; archives judicial files electronically and holds a database of cases and judgments, used by the judgment enforcement unit; no police station is mentioned

systems.system: البطاقات الجنائية (criminal record cards issued electronically through the same system)
systems.tiers: issued electronically and linked to other state bodies; used to clean municipal council electoral rolls

note: The system described is the Public Prosecution's, not the police's: it archives judicial files and issues criminal record cards. The 558 evidence-gathering records are a committee's count, with no system named. No fact for a station record system.
